basics.name: Jiaxi (Jay) Liu
basics.summary: My research focuses on cooperative perception, vehicle-road-cloud integration, language-model-assisted autonomous driving, and safety-critical scenario generation.
basics.label: Ph.D. Candidate in Civil & Environmental Engineering

work.summary: Research on cooperative perception, vehicle-road-cloud integration systems, and LLM-assisted autonomous driving.

education.detail: Also earned a second bachelor’s degree in Economics.

interests.label: Cooperative perception
interests.name: Cooperation under limited communication
interests.description: Identifying safety-relevant blind spots and deciding when, with whom, and what to share.

interests.label: Infrastructure sensing
interests.name: Sensing beyond the vehicle
interests.description: Using roadside infrastructure and UWB measurements to reconstruct work zones and support connected driving.

interests.label: Language-guided driving
interests.name: Language-guided driving
interests.description: Combining vision-language reasoning with trajectory prediction, planning, and vehicle control.

interests.label: Safety testing
interests.name: Calibrated safety testing
interests.description: Generating corner-case scenarios whose adversity is set as a percentile of the natural risk in the same traffic context.

publications.shortName: How corner is a corner case?
publications.summary: Percentile-controlled generation of highway corner cases, indexing each scenario's adversity by its risk percentile among the natural futures of the same traffic context.
publications.name: How corner is a corner case? Percentile control for highway scenario generation
publications.underReview: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
publications.imageAlt: Planner-test renderings of one highway scene generated at requested risk percentiles p = 0.1, 0.5, and 0.9, from the project page.

publications.summary: Work-zone pathway prediction that re-ranks geometric candidate paths with a vision-language model's trajectory and checks the choice against MUTCD-derived rules.
publications.name: SAGE: A hybrid vision-language and geometry framework for work-zone pathway prediction under temporary traffic control
publications.imageAlt: SAGE path predictions overlaid on nine ROADWork work-zone scenes from U.S. cities, from the project page.

publications.summary: Risk-aware cooperation that selects perception partners and shares safety-relevant information under limited communication bandwidth.
publications.name: SRA-CP: Spontaneous Risk-Aware Selective Cooperative Perception
publications.imageAlt: SRA-CP comparison of generic and risk-aware selective cooperative perception, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: Pose-conditioned UWB range denoising for reconstructing work-zone geometry from vehicle-to-infrastructure measurements.
publications.name: V2I Work Zone Geometry Reconstruction with Pose-Conditioned UWB Range Denoising
publications.imageAlt: UWB roadside units, vehicle-mounted sensors, and the real-world work-zone experiment layout, from Figure 3 of the paper.

publications.summary: A real-world cooperative perception dataset covering adverse weather, varied lighting, and complex traffic environments.
publications.name: CATS-V2V: A Real-World Vehicle-to-Vehicle Cooperative Perception Dataset with Complex Adverse Traffic Scenarios
publications.imageAlt: CATS-V2V multi-view images, combined point cloud, and bird’s-eye-view annotations from the project website.

publications.summary: A closed-loop driving controller combining vision-language reasoning with model predictive control.
publications.name: VLM-MPC: Model predictive controller augmented vision language model for autonomous driving
publications.publisher: Transportation Research Part C: Emerging Technologies
publications.imageAlt: VLM-MPC architecture combining vision-language planning with model predictive control, extracted from Figure 1 of the preprint.

publications.summary: Physics-informed Koopman learning that corrects a calibrated car-following law to identify automated-vehicle dynamics from short, noisy trajectories, with the CATS-CF car-following dataset.
publications.name: Physics-Informed Koopman Learning for Data-Efficient System Identification of Automated Vehicle Dynamics
publications.imageAlt: PI-Koopman framework from traffic observation to physics-informed Koopman learning and its applications, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: Lane-level detection of abnormal freeway traffic using sparse vehicle telematics.
publications.name: Real-time lane-level abnormal traffic detection on freeways using sparse telematics data
publications.imageAlt: Crash location on a segment of I-94 in Milwaukee and the corresponding time-space diagram, from Figure 2 of the paper.

publications.summary: A compact representation of spatial and temporal driving risk for vehicle-road-cloud perception and planning.
publications.name: Risk Occupancy: A New and Efficient Paradigm Through Vehicle-Road-Cloud Collaboration
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
publications.imageAlt: 4D risk occupancy of a traffic scene, from Figure 1(b) of the paper.

publications.summary: Geometry-aware UWB denoising that couples temporal range modeling with anchor-layout estimation for work-zone reconstruction.
publications.name: Geometry-Aware Infrastructure-Anchored Denoiser for UWB Sensing and Work-Zone Reconstruction
publications.imageAlt: Work-zone scenario, limitations of existing approaches, and the proposed GAIA approach, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: A dataset and benchmark for multimodal reasoning across vehicle, infrastructure, and cooperative viewpoints.
publications.name: V2X-QA: A Comprehensive Reasoning Dataset and Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Autonomous Driving Across Ego, Infrastructure, and Cooperative Views
publications.imageAlt: Overview of the V2X-QA tasks across ego-vehicle, infrastructure, and cooperative views, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: Risk-aware multimodal trajectory planning that incorporates semantic guidance for long-tail driving scenarios.
publications.name: HERMES: A Holistic End-to-End Risk-Aware Multimodal Embodied System with Vision-Language Models for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving
publications.imageAlt: Comparison of end-to-end, VLM-based, and HERMES driving frameworks, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: Conditional diffusion for car-following trajectory prediction, incorporating vehicle dynamics and inter-vehicle interactions.
publications.name: FollowGen: A scaled noise conditional diffusion model for car-following trajectory prediction
publications.imageAlt: FollowGen training and sampling processes for car-following trajectory prediction, from Figure 1 of the paper.

publications.summary: A review of vehicle-road-cloud collaborative perception architectures, fusion methods, and deployment challenges.
publications.name: Vehicle-Road-Cloud Collaborative Perception Framework and Key Technologies: A Review
publications.publisher: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems

publications.summary: A survey of local map construction using standard-definition maps as priors for intelligent driving.
publications.name: Local Map Construction with SDMap: A Comprehensive Survey
publications.imageAlt: General pipeline of local map construction with SDMap, from Figure 2 of the survey.

teaching.summary: an interactive lecture companion with five browser demos set in one hypothetical city, covering the four-step travel demand model, walking access to transit, and zone size.
